ragPlans.title: RAG system plans and pricing
ragPlans.subtitle: AI that answers with your company's documents and cites the source. Start with a 2-week pilot using your own documents.
ragPlans.taxNote: Prices in COP and USD, plus VAT if applicable.

piloto.name: RAG Pilot
piloto.tagline: Validate the AI with your own documents before rolling it out.
piloto.note: If you sign up for a plan within the following 30 days, we deduct 100% of what you paid for the pilot from the setup.

esencial.name: Essential
esencial.tagline: An assistant with your company's documents on your website.
features: One source (Drive, SharePoint or manual upload)
monthlyIncludes: AI for up to 3,000 questions per month

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.tagline: Multiple sources, web and WhatsApp, with role-based permissions and metrics.

empresarial.name: Enterprise
empresarial.tagline: Runs on your own infrastructure, with SSO and auditing.
features: Deployment on your cloud or on-premise

notes.title: Good to know
notes.tax: COP and USD prices exclude VAT, which is added if applicable.
notes.extraQuestion: Each additional question over your plan's monthly cap costs {cop} / {usd}.
notes.whatsapp: Meta's WhatsApp messaging fees are billed separately, at cost.
